meta.name: boost-asio-pro
meta.description: Use when writing or reviewing asynchronous C++ networking code with Boost.Asio or standalone Asio — TCP/UDP servers and clients, SSL/TLS, timers, strands, io_context, co_spawn, awaitable, async_read/async_write, asio::spawn, yield_context, or pre-C++20 completion-handler callbacks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出可靠高效的异步网络服务代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用 C++ 开发网络服务,需要处理复杂异步逻辑
copy.tagline_en: Write reliable and efficient async network services in C++
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building high-performance C++ network services and need guidance on async logic

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 写或审异步 C++ 网络代码时,会先确认你用的 Boost/Asio 版本与 C++ 标准,再选对应风格(如协程、回调等)来写或改,并套用版本门槛和反模式清单。
howto.when: 当你在编写或审查 Boost.Asio 或 standalone Asio 的异步 C++ 网络代码,涉及 TCP/UDP、SSL/TLS、定时器等话题时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Boost.Asio 写一个 TCP 服务器,用 C++20 协程。
say.note: Claude 先确认版本再按协程风格实现。

say.text: 检查这段 Asio 代码里 buffer 的生命周期有没有问题。
say.note: 会对照反模式清单审查。

say.text: 我的 Boost 是 1.74 和 C++11,该用哪种异步风格?
say.note: 会按版本表推荐回调风格。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude first determines the user's Boost/Asio version and C++ standard, then writes or reviews async C++ networking code in the matching style (e.g., coroutines or callbacks), applying version floors and anti-pattern checks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you write or review async C++ networking code with Boost.Asio or standalone Asio, e.g., TCP/UDP, SSL/TLS, timers, etc.

say_en.text: Write a TCP server using Boost.Asio with C++20 coroutines.
Review this Asio code for buffer lifetime issues.
I have Boost 1.74 and C++11 — which async style should I use?
say_en.note: Recommends callbacks per the version table.
